Main PDF p20 Recall Agent; tested exception in Q36
accepted.novelty: This tests the ordinary turn’s legal sources and movement, which constrain whether a player can manufacture further Agent turns by reusing placed Agents or played/discarded cards. Q04 requests costs/card capacity/no-icon legality, Q87 requests matching access icons, Q03/Q35 request later lifetime/destinations, and Q36 requests recall reuse. None requests the ordinary origin rule. This is a distinct foundational source rule, not different numbers/names or a recombination of existing cost/access cases. The question also explicitly requests the Agent-box/ignore-Reveal-box part of the same basic procedure; Q03 asks Reveal-side card eligibility, so this makes the Agent side direct without creating a standalone reverse-box variant.

source: Main PDF p17 Clarifications—Shaddam Corrino IV: restriction takes effect immediately on Signet Ring Agent placement
Main PDF p9 ordinary freedom to order board/card/Influence effects
FAQ PDF p3 Shaddam Corrino IV: only triggered turn, not remaining round
accepted.novelty: Consequential named exception to general Agent-effect ordering: onset has priority over deployment. Q43 requests duration but not onset or ordering; Q72 asks generic Signet activation versus Reveal; Q24 asks normal ordering and pre-entry prerequisites. These do not directly request whether the restriction can be postponed by ordering. This adds an explicitly source-defined timing/priority exception, not another duration or generic Signet variant.

Source-defined player-count branch: in four players the untied third-place finisher receives the third reward; in three or fewer this reward is used only for a tie for second. Q30 requests only the untied three-player case and two humans plus Rival. Q09 requests tied first in 4P; Q29 requests tied third and three-way tied first. Neither asks the untied 4P allocation. This is a different rulebook reward branch, not arbitrary changed numbers within an existing branch. Winner-card background is included for a self-contained answer but is not claimed as new coverage.

An actual setup permission not requested anywhere in the 93-question bank. Q21 explicitly requests selection/distribution of Objective cards and only the Shaddam restriction for Leaders. Q44 requests particular Leader initial states; Q84 requests deck and component preparation; neither asks how Leaders are selected. Choosing versus compulsory random assignment is a different source rule from random Objective distribution, not changed names or numbers in an existing branch.

The ordinary draw icon has an explicit card origin. Q23/Q80 request when round-start draws happen; Q39 requests during/after-Reveal timing; Q34 requests when reshuffling occurs. None requests which deck an ordinary draw effect uses. Q78 requests Intrigue deck versus opponent origins, a different draw mechanism. Existing board-space effects questions request that a card is drawn, but not the ordinary draw source or permission to select from discard. Only this origin is claimed as new; the reshuffle explanation repeats Q34 to make the answer usable.

Q20 asks only what happens after the House Hagal deck is empty or Reshuffle is drawn. Q60 asks starting Rival personal components/resources and what happens to the 2P Reshuffle card, not preparation of the shared deck. Q84 explicitly enumerates human starter, Intrigue, Imperium/Row and Reserve setup and does not include House Hagal. None of the remaining complete-bank questions requests the initial House Hagal shuffle. This is a source-prescribed initial state for the distinct automation mechanism, not a changed destination/resource/number in an existing visit or reward branch. The retained 2P card is repeated here only to make the setup answer complete, and is not claimed as new coverage.

accepted.novelty: Only the initial unowned/common-bank state is claimed as new coverage. This changes whether a normal human has the prerequisite before acquiring Hooks; it is not a different spice amount, destination name, Sietch option, or invented Leader exception. The acquisition destination supplies context for the ownership distinction and is not independently claimed as a new gap.

Main p14 explicitly prescribes an ongoing phase-3 update after strength was set during Reveal. Q08 asks pass/re-entry/closure and post-reward unit destinations; its key alone says adjust strength for effects, which receives no coverage credit. Q71 asks updates during the Reveal turn, not during Combat. Q07 asks the unit/sword formula and last-unit-zero exception, not maintaining a nonzero participant's marker after a Combat Intrigue resolves. Q69 asks only the separate automatic Rival bonus. Q91 asks reset after rewards. The new claim is this consequential Combat-window timing/procedure; the final-unit-zero and consecutive-pass reminders are repeated context only. No named-card or changed-number variant is proposed.

Accept exactly one grouped question for the single general resource-gain origin rule. Do not create separate Solari, spice and water variants. This is not a changed amount/name within a tested branch: an ordinary gain from the bank leaves opponents’ holdings intact, whereas taking from another player changes two players’ holdings. The source explicitly defines that legal origin. Q22’s correct incidental key clause cannot substitute for an actual requested question part.
